messages:
Jordan: uploaded the Feb Mar recurrence heatmap, link: https://redwood.internal/heatmaps/recur-2026. can folks triage the top hotspots?
Samira: quick scan 1: GPU OOMs during nightly batch windows, and small API 5xx spikes ~04:00 UTC.
Alex: OOMs are the largest cluster (42%); many align with model rollout on 2026-02-18.
Maria: the 04:00 spikes look like autoscaler flapping + cache cold starts (KV misses).
Jordan: OpsBot posted a digest earlier. OpsBot: incident-digest for 1969990000..1969994000.
OpsBot: automated note: recurring tags: "oom-nightly":12, "autoscale-spike":9, "fallback-rollback":3.
Esteban: I can own quantized-model fallback canary. will run 4-bit canary on a small dedicated pool. ETA 2026-03-10.
Samira: I'll own autoscaler investigation. plan: collect 7 days of scaler events + allocation logs, validate cooldown/capacity. ETA 2026-03-05.
Alex: I'll try to repro the OOM locally with a synthetic load; if repros we can ship mitigator next week.
Maria: short-term mitigations proposal:
 - increase nightly warm pool +20% for 2w
 - pin stable model variant during rollout windows
Jordan: good. capturing AOs now. I'll spin up a follow-up doc + kanban.
Jordan: action items (new):
``
- AO-1: Increase nightly warm pool by +20% (temp) -> owner: Maria -> due: 2026-03-03
- AO-2: Autoscaler cooldown audit + fix -> owner: Samira -> due: 2026-03-05
- AO-3: Repro OOM locally + propose mitigator -> owner: Alex -> due: 2026-03-04
- AO-4: Canary quantized fallback tests -> owner: Esteban -> due: 2026-03-10
- AO-5: Postmortem follow-up doc linking incidents -> owner: Jordan -> due: 2026-03-07
```
Samira: note for AO-2: I'll test change to cooldown=120s on staging first. Jordan: approved.
Maria: AO-1 scheduled for 02:15 UTC to avoid traffic windows.
Alex: added repro snippet: `python repro_oom.py --model gptx-6b --seq 1024 --batch 8`
Esteban: will report perf delta from canary and add fallback threshold: rollback if 5xx >0.5% for 3m.
Jordan: also request: add monthly heatmap job that auto-tags recurring signatures and pings owners. OpsBot: can schedule.
OpsBot: scheduled job 'recur-heatmap-monthly' -> first run 2026-04-01. notifying @Samira @Maria.
Maria: suggest including KV cache miss rate in monthly artifact to catch cold-start clusters.
Samira: ack. I'll add a small autoscaler config test matrix (cooldown, surge, target utilization).
Jordan: please update kanban when you progress. reconvene in 2 weeks for a sync.
Alex: :thumbsup:
Esteban: :thumbsup: will drop results into canary thread.
Samira: will add a summary row in incidents tracker linking AO items.
Jordan: flagged AO-3 and AO-4 as high priority since they reduce recurrence most.
Alex: noted.
Esteban: noted.
OpsBot: reminder set: AO-1 due in 3 days, AO-2 due in 6 days.
